layers.title: Signal Hill Zoning Districts
layers.notes:
Overview This feature service provides the City of Signal Hill’s zoning district information for municipal planning and land use reference. It represents official zoning areas used to support land use regulation, development review, and public-facing zoning inquiries within the city.
Layer Content Zoning — Polygon zoning districts with district code, district name, zoning type, and zoning symbol attributes that identify how each area is classified for planning and regulatory purposes.
